description: Record one decision an expert explicitly made, with their reason verbatim. Saved as agent-recorded and unconfirmed until a person confirms it; only for experts this machine lists.

criteria.description: Tags the reason relies on, e.g. no-source

reason.description: The expert's reason, exactly as they gave it; never reworded

ref.description: A link or id of the item

subject.description: What was judged, in one line

verdict.description: The expert's verdict: approved or rejected, or one of `verdicts`

verdicts.description: The verdict set, when it is not approved and rejected

items.description: A short lowercase label: letters, digits, "-" or "_"

name: record_judgment
title: Record a judgment
